# Antiphon the Sophist

*480 BCE – 411 BCE · Greek*

An Athenian sophist whose treatise *On Truth* survives on a papyrus. For him, the prescriptions of law are imposed conventions, those of nature are necessary, and one can break the former without harm if no one sees. Whether he is the same man as the orator Antiphon remains debated.
